{{Quote|We suspect remnants of an asteroid mining operation in the Udine system revolted and formed a pirate band. As they were aware of the hyperlane shortcut through nearby Keller's Void, they began towing immense asteroids to block starships and force them out of hyperspace.|[[Blissa Vlix]]|<ref name="QS" />}}
The '''Udine system''' was an uninhabited [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the vicinity of [[Keller's Void/Legends|Keller's Void]],<ref name="TVT" /> within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> This system had a high concentration of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]],<ref name="TVT" /> which formed the [[Udine asteroid field]].<ref name="QS" />

[[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]] were known to occasionally transport these asteroids to Keller's Void in order to drag [[Starship/Legends|ships]] from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], utilizing their [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadows]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|276|Udine system}}</ref>
